app.title: Calaverita Generator
app.tagline: Playful "Day of the Dead" verses for the people you love.

form.commaHint: Separate each item with a comma.

name.label: Who is the calaverita for?
name.tooLong: Keep the name to 40 characters or fewer.

pronouns.required: Choose pronouns so the verse fits your friend.

occupation.label: Occupation or hobby
occupation.tooLong: Keep this to 60 characters or fewer.

traits.label: A few traits or quirks
traits.placeholder: e.g. always late, loves coffee, plays guitar
traits.tooLong: Keep the traits to 200 characters or fewer.

error.blocked: La Catrina won't write that one. Calaveritas tease with love, so try different details.
error.refused: La Catrina couldn't come up with a kind enough verse this time. Try again or change the details.
error.unavailable: La Catrina ran out of ink and couldn't finish your calaverita.
error.busy: La Catrina is very busy right now. Try again in a moment.
error.timeout: La Catrina is taking too long. Let's try again.
error.invalid: Something in the form needs a second look.
error.rateLimited: You've written a lot of calaveritas in the last 10 minutes, so La Catrina is taking a breather. You can write another in about {minutes} min.

card.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the verse and copy it by hand.
card.downloadFailed: Couldn't make the image. Try again, or take a screenshot of the card.

quota.few: Heads up: you can write {count} more calaveritas in the next few minutes.
quota.one: Heads up: you can write 1 more calaverita in the next few minutes.
quota.none: That was your last calaverita for now. You can write more in about {minutes} min.
